request.subject: UNIT:DWARF:MARKSMAN

layers.text: Add only one thing: one big bright copper wind-up key sticking up out of its back behind the head, a short shaft with a wide flat two-lobed handle like a butterfly, clearly visible above the left shoulder. Do not change anything else: keep the green lamp, the iron body, the copper belly, the gatling arm, the claw, the legs, the steam, thick black outline and art style the same, on a transparent background.
